base: Fixed 50/50 natural-probability blend of the past_context_hgb and past_context_neural from the frozen native-depth screen. Both train only on May 27-30 and select on May 31. Exact parent checkpoint prediction parity is mandatory. Every June 1 training/validation base forecast is from this earlier model.
controls: Include all thirty-six predictors from the completed native-depth screen with exact saved-row and posterior parity. Compare residual depth to residual top-one at matched delay/loss/depth and to the unchanged source-union residual. No extra assessment-stage blend or hyperparameter grid.
features: Five fixed representations from the native-depth experiment: the 399-column source union and its top-one/top-25 additions at 100ms/500ms. Add the frozen base negative/neutral and positive/neutral log odds plus asset ID. Training-only .001/.999 clipping applies to observed fields and log odds.
hypothesis: Learn a conditional recent correction to a historical probability forecast. A fixed natural-probability blend can dilute new information, while a model trained only on one morning must relearn the entire relationship. Residual logit boosting starts from the frozen past-context HGB/MLP blend and learns only the new conditional correction.
mathematics: For class/asset-balanced cross entropy the initial raw margin is log(p_base)-log(pi_morning), where pi_morning is the true training asset class frequency. Recover natural probabilities by multiplying the learned q by pi_morning and normalizing. For natural cross entropy with equal asset weight, use log(p_base) and no prior multiplication. A zero correction therefore preserves the natural parent. The zero-round prediction returns the exact parent probability bytes because XGBoost iteration_range=(0,0) means the full model, not zero trees.
partitions: Identical June 1 full-morning training, actual release purges, morning validation and unchanged 7070 noon observations per asset as the native-depth screen. Morning fit/selection/checkpoint plus cached base inference must fit inside 290 seconds. No assessment labels enter fitting, preprocessing or checkpoint selection.
promotion: Exposed-date development only. No substantial gain is confirmed without a separately registered fresh-date confirmation.
selection: Train exactly one fixed 256-round path per configuration. Choose among 0,16,64,128,256 using mean asset balanced accuracy with the shared purged morning prior; tie break on natural log loss, then fewer rounds. Zero correction is an explicit candidate. Assessment scores are revealed only after all twenty paths and selected predictions are frozen.
source_scope: XGBoost documents base_margin for continuing from another model and iteration_range for staged predictions. The installed 2.1.3 signature and native runtime were checked directly. This mechanism supplies no empirical forecast gain by itself.
validation: Four mathematical/runtime test cases cover weighted logit rebasing, both natural and balanced calibration at a correct base, exact zero-correction identity, native save/reload, learning new missing information, and validation rejection of a harmful correction. Full suite and immutable input hashes are required before the first fit.
